title: Helicopter Helicopter
blurb: Fazlija recorded a Bosnian song called Helikopter and had no reasonable way of anticipating what TikTok would do with it. The chant is hypnotic in the most literal sense — the repetition and the rhythm bypass whatever part of your brain is responsible for getting songs out again — and it became the official soundtrack for rotation in all its forms: ceiling fans, figure skaters, office chairs, a life visibly spiralling. The parakofer parakofer is not an optional extra. It is the second rotor, and without it the whole thing falls out of the sky.
origin: From Fazlija's song 'Helikopter', viral as TikTok's spinning anthem.
